data.notes: The research stopped early: the shared WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn across all agents) ran out after about 20 searches by this agent. No further searches were possible. Coverage is therefore uneven. The best data, from ADAC Autokatalog plus VW Austria and Autozeitung, is for the Tiguan III and Tiguan II (facelift and pre-facelift). The Tayron has ADAC and AMS data for the eHybrid and only carwow for the combustion trunk. Touran and Touareg have only third-party data. The Tiguan Allspace is essentially empty (null values). Rules followed: trunk and dimension numbers come only from the sources listed. Engine power figures not confirmed in this run are flagged in each variant's notes; they are taken from the known VW line-ups and should be re-verified. Conflicts found: (1) Tiguan II eHybrid trunk, where ADAC and ACE give 615/1655 l and drivingelectric, autonotizen and autotijd give 476 l (476 used; it is consistent with the stated 139 l loss to the battery). (2) Touran trunk, where carwow gives 834/1980 l and autozeitung 1857 l. (3) Touareg trunk, where kofferraum.org claims 655 l, which conflicts with 665 l for the eHybrid. Possible missing model: the VW Sharan (7N), an MPV sold until about 2022 in the same segment as the Touran, was not researched and is listed in notFound. A follow-up run with a fresh search budget should cover the Tiguan Allspace, the Touareg's non-hybrid trunk and wheelbase, the Tayron's 7-seat and folded volumes, the Touran's official volumes, and the Sharan.
